entries.name: v5-missing-exp-v0-accept#0
entries.description: The probe's `exp` tree at tree version 0, UNSIZED. The JVM parses it and round-trips it verbatim. **THE SEPARATING ROW:** an implementation whose method table lacks this id refuses it at the lookup, and at an unsized tree it has no degrade path, so it REJECTS a carrier the JVM accepts — an over-reject.

entries.name: v5-missing-exp-v3-accept#1
entries.description: The same `exp` tree SIZE-FLAGGED at v3. **THE CONTROL OF THIS PAIR:** a refusing implementation now degrades and echoes the very bytes the JVM echoes, so the row is green whether the method id was understood or skipped — the wire tier is degrade-blind and cannot tell those apart. Its v0 twin is where the disagreement shows.
